# Security

- SEC-001: No secrets in the repo: no keys, tokens, passwords or connection strings with credentials, in any file or commit.
- SEC-002: Agents never read, print or store secrets, and never retrieve credentials from browsers or password managers; sign-in is always the owner's step.
- SEC-003: Agents ask the owner before spending money or touching cloud resources, deleting or rewriting anything on GitHub or unmerged work, creating an app repo or making anything public, merging a release PR or publishing a release, changing a ruleset, branch protection or merge settings, turning off Dependabot alerts or security updates, removing or weakening a CI check, adding a connector, installing software, switching the working mode or merging a change to the guardrails, or doing anything else that can't be undone; in review mode, also before adding a dependency, changing CI or other repo settings, or acting outside the repo.
